description: Hextraction is a free, open‑source, 3D‑printable board game created by Zack Freedman, where players place tiles and race a 10 mm steel ball down a modular hex‑grid board. This one does require access to a 3D printer and does not have an online application. Our developer g0m is super passionate about Hextraction so hit him up in the official Pyramid Discord if you're interested!
name: Hextraction

objectives.co_op_rules: Flip primary objectives equal to the # of players, everyone must complete a primary objective with the flipped secondary objective
